resumos: The ability to filter search results based on metadata fields (frontmatter) such as tags, categories, or dates, which is particularly useful for organizing and querying large collections of Markdown notes.
根据 frontmatter 元数据过滤搜索结果的方法。
Nutzung von OpenSearch-Filtern (Term Queries) auf Basis der im Frontmatter extrahierten Metadaten.
Filtragem de documentos por metadados definidos no frontmatter, implementável em SQL ou consultas de API.
A technique to filter search results based on metadata fields in frontmatter.
